source.subject: test: reject packed-B cache-all NVFP4 Gate

purpose.question: After A-only cp.async.ca establishes the fastest native M64xN256 cell, does also caching packed B reduce enough global traffic to improve the otherwise identical kernel?
purpose.answer: No. Caching packed B reduces matched NCU L2 request bytes by 17.651032% and bypass bytes by 84.581498%, but regresses every formal timing round and raises aggregate Gate latency by 5.742675%.
purpose.classification: reject packed-B cache-all and retain the A-only-CA M64xN256 test baseline
purpose.production_route: unchanged hybrid direct-dequant plus cuBLASLt bridge

shape_and_topology.grid: 68 N tiles x 8 M tiles = 544 CTAs
shape_and_topology.mma: sixteen inline mma.sync.aligned.m16n8k16 BF16 accumulator fragments per warp
shape_and_topology.candidate_cache_policy: activation A and packed B use cp.async.ca; scale windows remain cp.async.cg
shape_and_topology.control_cache_policy: activation A uses cp.async.ca; packed B and scale windows use cp.async.cg
shape_and_topology.scale_reuse: one K256 16-byte scale window per output row, retained for four K64 stages
shape_and_topology.packed_weight_copy: paired adjacent lanes fill both 16-byte halves of one canonical 32-byte packed row
shape_and_topology.comparison_baseline: the retained M64xN256 A-only-CA test cell with identical topology, arithmetic, pipeline, and epilogue

sass_cache_operator_evidence.measurement: static LDGSTS instruction sites in the instantiated kernels, not dynamic traffic

candidate_m64n256_abca.non_bypass_roles: six activation-A and six packed-B sites

control_m64n256_aca.bypass_roles: six packed-B and three scale-window sites

sass_cache_operator_evidence.conclusion: The compiled candidate adds cache-all only to the six packed-B copies; activation A remains cache-all and scale windows remain bypassing. The tile, arithmetic, pipeline, resources, and epilogue are unchanged.

correctness_and_rejection_contract.independent_audit: pass with no blocking code, ABI, resource, correctness, Graph, cache-operator, or production-isolation findings

protocol.control: retained M64xN256 activation-A-only cp.async.ca; packed B and scales cp.async.cg
protocol.candidate: identical M64xN256 kernel with activation A and packed B on cp.async.ca; scales cp.async.cg
protocol.pair_stop_loss: skip Gate+Up pair unless the single-Gate candidate clears both the positive-round and absolute-latency gates

aggregate.decision: reject packed-B cache-all; retain the A-only-CA baseline and keep production unchanged

screen_log.expected_exit: nonzero because all six relative rounds and the absolute candidate gate reject the candidate

protocol.clock_control: none inside Nsight Compute; the system was already fixed at MAXN CPU/GPU/EMC clocks
protocol.use: causal attribution for the same topology and sole packed-B cache-operator change, not formal latency
protocol.warning: Nsight Compute did not flush caches or change clocks. Same binary, M64xN256 topology, resources, arithmetic, activation-A operator, scale operator, and epilogue are compared; the CPU-11-pinned B-C-C-B screen remains authoritative for latency.

nsight_compute_comparison.interpretation: The candidate demonstrably moves the intended packed-B copies onto cache-access and substantially reduces L2 and bypass traffic, yet profiled duration increases 5.4785%, tensor and issue activity fall, and MIO throttle rises 2.69 points. On this SM87 M64 topology, putting the streaming packed-B payload through L1 is harmful despite fewer L2 request bytes; packed B must retain cp.async.cg.

independent_audit.findings: no blocking code, ABI, resource, correctness, Graph, cache-operator, or production-isolation findings

decision.retained_value: preserve the implementation and evidence as a sentinel that lower L2 traffic alone does not justify caching the large streaming packed-B payload
decision.retained_native_baseline: M64xN256 A-only cp.async.ca with packed B and scales on cp.async.cg
decision.absolute_gate: unchanged and failed by 0.394009 ms; the candidate also fails the relative gate in all six rounds

next_bounded_work.direction: decode or instruction-scheduling structural change on the retained A-only-CA topology
next_bounded_work.admission_rule: retain the 5.304339 ms absolute Gate threshold and the six-round strict-positive rule
next_bounded_work.scope_guard: test-only until both single-Gate gates clear; run Gate+Up pair only afterward

do_not_repeat: do not cache packed B through L1 on the current M64xN256 pipeline
do not infer performance from lower L2 request bytes without timing and issue-path counters
do not run Gate+Up pair timing after the frozen single-Gate stop-loss
do not change production dispatch or route MTP as a shortcut
